latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the gitbook-skill – a comprehensive guide for editing GitBook documentation in external environments.

- Provides detailed explanations of GitBook content structure and configuration files.
- Includes formatting syntax, recommended best practices, and usage of custom blocks.
- Outlines workflows for working with both new and existing GitBook projects synced via Git.
- Features quick references for frontmatter, variables, expressions, and linking conventions.
- Covers .gitbook/ directory purpose and .gitbook.yaml configuration, including monorepo support.
